title: 有馬記念の後に・さまよう

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder makes a valiant attempt, but victory slips through her grasp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her spirits are further dampened by the thought that this result would have been the same even if Maruzensky had been in the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky is disappointed in Grass Wonder, noting that she wasn't fully focused on the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Only then does Grass Wonder realize she hasn't truly clashed with her contemporaries.
